name: The majority voted against amendment (1) on sheet 1937 revised 2, which was introduced by Victorian Senator [Sarah Henderson](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/victoria/sarah_henderson) (Liberal), meaning it was not successful. ### What do the amendments do? Senator Henderson [explained that](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-06-19.199.1): > *This provides that the bill effectively proceed the day after this act receives royal assent and the day after a copy of the proposed STARTUP-HELP guidelines have been tabled in the Senate. I appreciate that the guidelines have now been tabled in the Senate, but I would still like to put that to the Senate please.* ### Amendment text > *(1) Clause 2, page 2 (cell at table item 1, column 2), omit the cell, substitute:* > >> *The later of:* >> >>> *(a) the day after this Act receives the Royal Assent; and* >>> >>> *(b) the day after a copy of the proposed STARTUP-HELP Guidelines has been tabled in the Senate.* >> >> *However, the provisions do not commence at all if the event mentioned in paragraph (b) does not occur.*
